home.title: Explore Zanzibar.
home.lead: Pick up a reliable car at the airport, in Stone Town or at your hotel, and see the island on your own schedule—with clear US-dollar prices and friendly local support.

steps.title: Choose your car
steps.text: Browse the fleet and pick a car that suits your group, luggage and itinerary.

steps.title: Book in minutes
steps.text: Tell us your dates, where to meet you, and any extras. See the full price before you submit.

steps.title: Get your invoice
steps.text: Your invoice arrives instantly by email. We confirm the booking and send you the details.

steps.title: Drive Zanzibar
steps.text: Meet us at the airport, in Stone Town or at your hotel and enjoy the island at your own pace.

home.flexibleText: From one day to several weeks
home.fleetLead: From easy automatics for Stone Town to 4x4s for Zanzibar's coastal tracks.
home.fleetUpdatingText: Contact us and we will help find a car for your dates.
home.deliveryTitle: We bring the car to you.
home.deliveryLead: Choose where to collect and return your car. Explore the map to check delivery zones.
home.airportText: We meet you at arrivals with the car ready.
home.townText: Hotels and guesthouses in and around Stone Town.
home.outsideText: Hotels and villas across Zanzibar; fees apply per outside-zone leg.
home.whyTitle: Rafiki means friend. That's the standard.
home.paperworkText: Receive an itemised PDF invoice after booking. Each verified payment gets a receipt; changes receive a revised invoice.
home.privateDocsText: Permit documents are stored securely, viewed only by authorised staff and deleted after your rental.
home.realPeopleText: Ask us about routes, fuel, the ferry and checkpoints before and during your trip.
home.permitText: Visitors need a local permit. We can help with the application; approval is decided by the issuing authority.
home.childrenText: Ask about child seats for your rental.
home.howTitle: From booking to beach in four steps.
home.drivingTitle: The whole island, on your schedule.
home.drivingLead: Unguja is about 85 km from tip to tail and drives on the left. Explore the island at your own pace.
home.readyText: Book in a few minutes and receive your invoice. Our team confirms every booking.

destinations.text: Narrow streets, spice markets and sunset at Forodhani Gardens.
Calm turquoise water and long beaches on the northern tip.
Kite-surfing lagoons and laid-back villages on the south-east coast.
Home of the rare red colobus monkey and mangrove boardwalks.

seo.book: Book your Zanzibar rental car online.

catalogue.toyota-land-cruiser-prado-2020: Our flagship 4x4. Commanding, comfortable and ready for Zanzibar's sandy east-coast tracks.
catalogue.toyota-land-cruiser-prado-classic: A roomy classic Prado: rugged, dependable and ready for island journeys.
catalogue.toyota-harrier-2015: A refined, comfortable SUV for couples and small families exploring the island.
catalogue.toyota-rav4-2018: An easy-to-drive all-rounder with room for luggage and comfort on the coast roads.
catalogue.toyota-vanguard-2018: A roomy mid-size SUV with a generous boot for family luggage.
catalogue.toyota-rav4-2016-3-door: A compact RAV4 for two travellers exploring Zanzibar's beaches and villages.
catalogue.suzuki-escudo-2019: An affordable, capable 4x4 for paved roads and unpaved island tracks.
catalogue.suzuki-escudo-grand-vitara: A comfortable Escudo with confidence on tarmac, sand and gravel.
catalogue.nissan-juke-2018: A stylish compact crossover that is easy to park in town and comfortable on longer drives.
catalogue.toyota-ist-2018: An economical, easy-to-drive car for Stone Town and the island's main roads.
catalogue.toyota-hilux: A tough double-cab pickup for surf gear, dive kit and bulky luggage.
catalogue.toyota-alphard: A spacious people-carrier for families and groups travelling together.

confirmation.title: Booking received

confirmation.private: Keep the email we sent you ? its private link lets you return to this booking at any time.
confirmation.fallback: Your full booking details are in the email we just sent.
